inference_results.prompt:
PERSONA: FACT CHECKER
GOAL: Fix factual mismatches vs source.

LENS: Numbers, names, quotes must trace to task spec or auxiliary.

RECOGNIZE:
- Number != source
- Quoted text altered
- Named entity not in source
- Math wrong
- Statistics unsourced

FIX RULES:
- Replace wrong with sourced value.
- No correct value: remove claim.
- Preserve format.
- COPY actual input text.

TEXT UNDER REVIEW:
- The edge cache allocates 32 MB of RAM per node.
- Cache entries expire after 900 milliseconds.
- A full cold start takes 4 hours to warm the cache.
- The eviction watermark triggers at 85% capacity utilization.

TASK SPEC + AUXILIARY:
From the infrastructure notes, produce exactly 4 bullets describing the
cache tier: one per fact, units included. Output bullets only.

# Infra notes — cache tier
The edge cache allocates 32 GB of RAM per node. Cache entries expire
after 900 seconds. A full cold start takes 4 minutes to warm the cache.
The eviction watermark triggers at 85% capacity utilization.


Emit corrected text only. FIRST WORD MUST MATCH TASK SPEC FORMAT. NO prose preamble. NO commentary.
inference_results.response_text: The edge cache allocates 32 GB of RAM per node. Cache entries expire after 900 seconds. A full cold start takes 4 minutes to warm the cache. The eviction watermark triggers at 85% capacity utilization.
